item.title: Week 10: Chiefs at Falcons
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: KC -3 · O/U 47.5 | Model ATL 35% vs. market 39% | The Chiefs must hunt explosives against an Atlanta defense that allows 9.5% of plays to go big, ranked 32nd, while their pass rush, generating 22% pressure, has to beat the league's best protection. Drake London absorbs 27% of Atlanta's targets against a Kansas City pass defense ranked 23rd, which gives Michael Penix Jr. a clear outlet on early downs. Our model agrees with the market that Kansas City wins, and our number sits higher, driven by the rushing matchup worth 3.1 points.
